description: Read rows of one table (plus up to three joined tables) with filters, ordering and keyset paging. Values come back as released by the publisher (value_layer). Each of columns is [name, type, has Refused / Don't know codes]; labels, units and codes are in describe_data. Returns data_available: false with the quoted terms when the dataset may not be passed on; never retry a refusal with other arguments. A non-blank value does not mean the person met the official collection or eligibility condition, and a blank does not mean "no": it can mean the question was not asked or the value was not computed.

columns.description: Default: the table's default_columns. Primary key columns are always returned first. With join: <join>.<col> names a column of the joined table.

join.description: One table, or 1-3 tables, each joined to table along a declared relation (describe_data relations). Every row of table is kept; columns of a joined table are named <join>.<col>.

recode_na.description: true: each column's own Refused / Don't know codes (na_codes) become null before filtering and in the rows.

value.description: eq ne lt le gt ge: one value; in: 1-100 values; between: [low, high], both included; is_null, not_null: omit.

name: query_data
title: Read rows of a callable table
